decision_rule.vi: Dựng dependency/call-state graph trước; chỉ gọi operation khi input và state version mà nó cần đã sẵn sàng.
decision_rule.en: Build the dependency/call-state graph first; call an operation only when its required inputs and state version are ready.

cases.description: setup/read, transform/search and output in dependency order
each iteration owns its input, return and branch
output state before and after one mutating call without reimplementing it

variants.invariant: After each orchestration event, every completed call has received the source-required arguments, its result/state version is owned once, and every pending call still has a satisfiable precondition.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Sau mỗi event, call đã hoàn tất nhận đúng arguments và state version; result chỉ có một owner và call chờ vẫn còn precondition khả thi.
invariant_bilingual.en: After each orchestration event, every completed call has received the source-required arguments, its result/state version is owned once, and every pending call still has a satisfiable precondition.

decision_rule.vi: Viết output grammar và iterator/range trước; mỗi output event phải khớp một record/cell trong đúng order và không đổi dữ liệu gốc.
decision_rule.en: Write the output grammar and iterator/range first; each output event must match one record/cell in exact order without mutating source data.

cases.description: one complete labelled record per line in source order
all specified rows/cells including unused slots
concatenate exact fields/literals into the required return type

variants.invariant: After k output events, the rendered prefix exactly matches the first k items of the source-selected sequence under the required labels, separators, line breaks and type contract.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Sau k output events, rendered prefix khớp chính xác k items đầu theo labels, separators, line breaks và type contract nguồn.
invariant_bilingual.en: After k output events, the rendered prefix exactly matches the first k items of the source-selected sequence under the required labels, separators, line breaks and type contract.

decision_rule.vi: Lập evidence matrix case→setup→visible input→expected observable→capture slot; gắn nhãn official hoặc AlgoCore trước Stage 5/6.
decision_rule.en: Build an evidence matrix case→setup→visible input→expected observable→capture slot, labelled official or AlgoCore before Stage 5/6.

cases.description: one official input/output capture with complete attribution
each official case has its own reset, state lineage and capture slot
capture required file contents and visible filename without asserting execution

variants.invariant: Every planned capture is attributable to exactly one test case and shows all source-required observable evidence, while no Stage 4 field states that execution, output or screenshot already exists.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Mỗi planned capture gắn đúng một case và đủ observable bắt buộc; không field Stage 4 nào tuyên bố execution/output/screenshot đã tồn tại.
invariant_bilingual.en: Every planned capture is attributable to exactly one test case and shows all source-required observable evidence, while no Stage 4 field states that execution, output or screenshot already exists.
